correction_summary: The original morning send described the D23 2026 Kingdom Hearts anime teaser key visual as a 'cloaked/hooded figure... identity unconfirmed.' This traces back to an inaccurate secondary-source description (Hypebeast's own article prose calls it a 'cloaked figure holding a Keyblade') that was never checked against the actual promotional image itself before the original send. Sebastian directly inspected the real, actual promotional image and confirmed this description is wrong: the figure has fully visible dark hair (no hood covering it) and fur-trimmed clothing across the shoulders (no cloak anywhere in the image). Corrected VO, hook_line/opening_sentence, question_line, hook_candidates, angle, vo_required_beats, claim_source_matrix, all four clips (scene text and claim_vs_source_check fields), clip_descriptions, and tiktok_post_text to describe the real image (dark hair, fur-trimmed clothing) instead of the inaccurate cloaked/hooded framing. The still-live Helgi/Dark Road fan theory is preserved and re-worded to match the corrected visual description ('fans comparing the fur trim and outfit think it's Helgi') rather than removed, since that theory itself remains real, sourced (Complex.com), and appropriately hedged as unconfirmed.

fetch_review.claim: [NON-CORE, morning -- CORRECTED THIS BATCH] The key visual shows a cloaked figure from behind whose identity is not confirmed as Sora.
fetch_review.note: THIS IS THE CLAIM BEING CORRECTED. The original af6c90bf approval marked this claim as fetched_content_supports_claim=true, on the basis that Hypebeast's own article prose describes the visual as 'a cloaked, hooded figure holding a Keyblade... shown from behind.' That description accurately reflected what the ARTICLE'S TEXT said, but the article's text itself is an inaccurate secondary-source description of the actual image -- it was never checked against the real promotional image directly. Sebastian directly inspected the real, actual promotional image (not a re-fetched URL -- this is a direct visual review, since the inaccuracy is in how a real image was described in prose, not in whether a URL loads or what a page's text says) and confirmed: the figure has fully visible dark hair, not covered by any hood, and fur-trimmed clothing across the shoulders, not a cloak. There is no cloak or hood anywhere in the actual image. Marking fetched_content_supports_claim=false here because the claim as originally worded ('cloaked figure... identity unconfirmed') is not supported by the real image, even though it was supported by a secondary source's inaccurate prose description of that image. The claim has been corrected in this batch's run_manifest.json to: 'The key visual shows a figure with dark hair and fur-trimmed clothing, not Sora's usual look, whose identity is not confirmed (CORRECTED from an earlier inaccurate 'cloaked/hooded figure' description).' This corrected claim is verified via Sebastian's direct visual inspection of the real image, logged in run_manifest.json's sources[] as verification_method='direct_visual_inspection_by_sebastian', url=null (intentionally null -- there is no new URL to cite; the correction basis is direct visual review of the same image, not a different or re-fetched source).
